description:
Members of an LIS legume gene family across chickpea, lentil, pea, soybean and Medicago truncatula. gene: a
chickpea/lentil/pea/Medicago gene ID, a soybean Ensembl ID (GLYMA_01G000600) or LIS name (Glyma.01G000600), or a
family ID (Legume.fam3.00142). Use it to go from a soybean or pea gene (e.g. from orthologues or expression
results) to its chickpea and lentil relatives, or back. Families are broader than orthologue groups. dataset
(e.g. 'chickpea_desi' or 'chickpea_kabuli_v1') picks one when a Ca_ ID exists in several annotations.
name: legume_family
